mv_confounding — MULTIVAR identifiability op

• 数据种类:matrix → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mv_confounding(S=None, names=None, threshold=10.0, log_params=False, max_subset=None) -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import sensitivity; sensitivity.mv_confounding(S=None, names=None, threshold=10.0, log_params=False, max_subset=None) -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsmultivar.get("mv_confounding"))

• GPU:无(仅 CPU 参考实现)

用法

共线性指数 gamma_K（Brun、Reichert 与 Künsch 2001）：数据能确定哪些参数。

> 以下的详细说明为原文 —— 摘要与标题已翻译。

S is the sensitivity matrix (observations x parameters): column j = the change of every output per change of parameter j (finite differences of a simulation, or a Jacobian), ideally already scaled to be dimensionless (Brun: s_ij = dtheta_j / sc_i * dy_i/dtheta_j). Each column is normalised to unit length, s~_j = s_j / ||s_j||, and for a parameter subset K

gamma_K = 1 / sqrt( min eigenvalue of S~_K^T S~_K ).

gamma_K = 1 for orthogonal columns; it grows when a change in one parameter can be compensated by the others (Brun et al. use 10-15 as the critical range; threshold defaults to 10). Returned: delta_msqr (importance, sqrt(mean s_ij^2) on the given scale), gamma of the full set and of every subset up to max_subset (all subsets for <= 14 parameters), the confounded_pairs (gamma > threshold), the largest identifiable subsets, the undetermined_direction of the full set (eigenvector of the smallest eigenvalue: moving the parameters along it barely changes the output), and per confounded_groups entry (the union of the minimal confounded subsets) the combinations the data determined (eigenvalue of the group's S~^T S~ >= 1/threshold^2) and those undetermined; parameters in no group are determined_individually. With log_params=True (columns are sensitivities to log parameters) the combinations are written as products of powers — e.g. n^1 * d^1 when only the product of refractive index and thickness reaches the data. Columns that are all zero are reported as no_influence and left out of gamma.
